title: 第1760章 金字招牌第1759章 我三姨夫挺有名的
content_zh:
金雕大妖们发现了妖王的变化，笑声很快消失。
一个个惊疑不定，盯着桌上的匕首，想要看出点端倪。
为何妖王看到匕首就不笑了，而且脸色变得十分难看。
可怎么看，都是一件普通的法器而已。
匕首连法宝都算不上。
不仅大妖们疑惑，千玑夫人也在疑惑不已。
她也想不通为何云极扔出一把法器匕首，天烁帝君居然就像见了鬼一样。
至于女帝楚天心，更是一脸茫然。
云极方才胡编乱造的一通话，楚天心完全明白其真正的用意，简单来说就是造势而已。
将无尘子当做三姨父，来震慑这群大妖。
可造势的手段太过拙劣，别说金雕一族的大妖不会相信，即便是女帝自己，听了也不信啊。
无尘树是云州大地最为古老的一株神木，存在了几千甚至上万年之久，而云极仅仅二十出头的年纪，你这亲戚攀得实在匪夷所思。
你三姨夫活了上万年，你三姨得多大岁数？
楚天心苍白的脸庞上现出淡淡苦笑，摇了摇头，又点了点头。
摇头，
是在无奈着云极的信口雌黄，胡编乱造。
点头，
实在肯定着云极的胆量，敢在群妖环伺之下说胡话，这种勇气可不是谁都有的。
云极扔出匕首之后，非但没有丝毫惧意，反而愈发狂傲起来。
拉了把椅子，大马金刀的坐了下来。

左手掐着女帝，右手拎着白狐，好似一位旗开得胜的将军，眼角眉梢尽是桀骜之色。
目中无人，狂到没边儿。
把无尘子当三姨夫这种笑话，说出来的确好笑，也没人会相信。
不过天烁帝君，信了。
这位雷裂崖的妖王，小心翼翼的抓起眼前的匕首，一个劲儿的打量，眼珠子瞪得溜圆，鼻口也在不断晃动，使劲儿嗅着气味。
好像手里的不是匕首，而是什么怪物一样。
苍羽觉得古怪，凑过去看了看匕首，疑惑道：“大哥，这匕首很普通嘛，人族法器，不值钱啊，好像刚切过什么东西。”
天烁帝君的眼皮在狂跳，沉声道：“切过树……”
“那就是砍柴刀呗！个头太小了，我记得人族的砍柴刀比这个要大，这种小匕首砍柴老费劲了。”苍羽凭借着对人族的了解，点评道。
“老幺，你敢不敢在无尘树上切一刀？”天烁帝君忽然问了句。
“我又没疯！找死啊！”
苍羽吓了一跳，惶恐道：“树老心情好了才会赏赐几片树叶，一群妖物在地面争抢，谁敢触碰树干那不是找死么！更别说切一刀了，无尘树上连鸟都不敢落！”
“是啊，树老能赏赐树叶，甚至允许群妖争夺果实，可是树干相当于逆鳞，不可触及……”
天烁帝君感叹了一句，神色古怪的盯着云极问道：“你用这匕首，去切无尘树了？”
云极呵呵一笑，神态随意的道：“白天太晒，切点树皮做个凉帽遮阳，帝君若是喜欢，明儿我给你也做一顶，对了老舅，你要什么颜色的，绿的怎么样。”
“行啊，绿帽子显得清凉……”
苍羽下意识的接话，说完他脸都绿了，惊呼道：“无尘树皮做帽子？老子不要！你别给我绿帽子戴！我害怕！”
不止苍羽在惧怕，其他大妖变得目瞪口呆，一个个如同木雕一般，全都傻了。
割树皮很常见，砍树也正常，可如果是去割无尘树的树皮，那就是天方夜谭了。
别说大妖不敢，妖王也不敢呐！

无尘树没事儿赏赐些树叶，相当于人族拔几根头发，无伤大雅，可谁要是敢用刀去人家身上挖块肉，你看人家跟你拼命不。
天烁帝君，感知到了匕首上携带着无尘树的气息。
content_en:
The golden eagle demons discovered the changes in the demon king, and their laughter quickly disappeared.
Everyone was in shock and doubt, staring at the dagger on the table, trying to get some clues.
Why did the Demon King stop smiling when he saw the dagger, and his face became very ugly.
But no matter how you look at it, it's just an ordinary magic weapon.
The dagger is not even a magic weapon.
Not only the big demons were confused, but Mrs. Qianji was also confused.
She also couldn't figure out why Emperor Tianshuo seemed to have seen a ghost when Yunji threw a magic weapon dagger.
As for the empress Chu Tianxin, she looked even more confused.
Chu Tianxin completely understood the real intention of the phone call that Yunji had just made up. Simply put, it was just to build momentum.
Treat Wuchenzi as his third uncle to scare these big monsters.
But the means of creating momentum are too clumsy. Not to mention the great demon of the Golden Eagle clan would not believe it, even the empress herself would not believe it after hearing it.
The Wuchen Tree is the oldest sacred tree in Yunzhou. It has existed for thousands or even tens of thousands of years. However, Yunji is only in his early twenties. It is incredible that your relative can climb it.
Your third uncle has lived for tens of thousands of years. How old is your third aunt?
A faint bitter smile appeared on Chu Tianxin's pale face, he shook his head and nodded again.
Shake his head,
They are helplessly following Yunji's nonsense and making up random things.
Nod,
It really affirms Yunji's courage, daring to talk nonsense while surrounded by monsters. Not everyone has this kind of courage.
After Yunji threw the dagger, instead of showing any fear, he became even more arrogant.
Pulling up a chair, Da Ma Jin Dao sat down.
Holding the empress in his left hand and holding the white fox in his right hand, he looked like a victorious general, with an unruly look on his eyes and brows.
Arrogant and crazy to the point of no one.
The joke about Wu Chenzi being his third uncle was really funny, but no one would believe it.
But Emperor Tianshuo believed it.
The Demon King of Thunder Split Cliff carefully grabbed the dagger in front of him and looked at it carefully. His eyes widened and his nose and mouth were constantly wagging as he sniffed hard.
It was as if what was in his hand was not a dagger, but some kind of monster.
Cang Yu felt weird, so he went over to look at the dagger and said doubtfully: "Brother, this dagger is very ordinary. It's a human magic weapon. It's not valuable. It seems like it has just cut something."
Emperor Tianshuo's eyelids were twitching wildly, and he said in a deep voice: "Cut the tree..."
"That's a woodchopping knife! It's too small. I remember that the human race's woodchopping knife is bigger than this. It's very difficult to chop wood with this small dagger." Cang Yu commented based on his understanding of the human race.
"My dear, do you dare to cut the Wuchen tree?" Emperor Tianshuo suddenly asked.
"I'm not crazy! I'm looking for death!"
Cang Yu was startled and said in panic: "The old tree will reward you with a few leaves when you are in a good mood. A group of monsters are fighting for it on the ground. Whoever dares to touch the trunk is asking for death! Let alone cutting it with a knife. Even the birds dare not fall on the dust-free tree!"
"Yes, the tree elder can reward leaves and even allow groups of monsters to compete for the fruits, but the trunk is equivalent to a reverse scale and cannot be touched..."
Emperor Tianshuo sighed, stared at Yunji with a strange expression and asked, "Did you use this dagger to cut the Wuchen tree?"
Yun Ji chuckled and said casually: "It's too sunny during the day. Cut some bark and make a hat to protect yourself from the sun. If the emperor likes it, I will make one for you tomorrow. By the way, uncle, what color do you want? How about green."
"Okay, cuckold looks cool..."
Cang Yu answered subconsciously, and after speaking, his face turned green, and he exclaimed: "Making a hat from dust-free bark? I don't want it! Don't cuckold me! I'm scared!"
Not only Cang Yu was afraid, the other big demons became dumbfounded. They were all dumbfounded like wooden sculptures.
Cutting the bark of trees is very common, and cutting down trees is normal, but if you are cutting the bark of dust-free trees, it is a fantasy.
Not to mention that the big demon doesn’t dare, even the demon king doesn’t dare!
dust free treeIt's okay to give some leaves as a reward, which is equivalent to pulling out a few hairs among humans. It's harmless, but if anyone dares to use a knife to dig out a piece of flesh from someone else's body, you will see if they will fight you.
Emperor Tianshuo sensed that the dagger carried the breath of Wuchen Tree.
